description: This header file declares callback functions and interfaces for the Dcm module in an AUTOSAR-compliant automotive software stack. It includes function prototypes for communication buffer provision, transmission confirmation, reception indication, and communication mode notifications, referencing external types from 'ComStack_Types.h'.

methods.name: Dcm_ProvideRxBuffer
methods.description: Provides a receive buffer for a specified PDU and its length, returning status.

methods.name: Dcm_RxIndication
methods.description: Indicates reception completion status for a specified PDU.

methods.name: Dcm_ProvideTxBuffer
methods.description: Provides a transmit buffer for a specified PDU and length.

methods.name: Dcm_TxConfirmation
methods.description: Confirms transmission completion status for a specified PDU.

methods.name: Dcm_ComM_NoComModeEntered
methods.description: Notification callback when No Communication mode is entered.

methods.name: Dcm_ComM_SilentComModeEntered
methods.description: Notification callback when Silent Communication mode is entered.

methods.name: Dcm_ComM_FullComModeEntered
methods.description: Notification callback when Full Communication mode is entered.
